sessionName: VO2max 5×1000m @ I (90 s rec) — gold standard
intro: Decisive I-band test: open at the 7:00 fast end and run 90 s JOG recoveries — the walked-recovery pattern is two-for-two and this is the session where it invalidates the read (Adj #251/#252/#270).

flags: Recoveries are 90 s JOG, not walked (Adj #252/#270). Jogging holds ventilation up so the reps accumulate time near VO2max; walking turns the session into five independent efforts and is the confound blocking the band question.
Full dose, no trimming — ~17.5 min of I work is what makes this read honest against W16 Sun's 12 min (Adj #251).
